in_marathi.name: Rajbha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rajbha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Raj means 'king, ruler' and Bha means 'manifestation, appearance'. Together, Rajbha means 'manifestation of a king or ruler'.

in_bengali.long_meaning: Rajbha একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Raj means 'king, ruler' and Bha means 'manifestation, appearance'. Together, Rajbha means 'manifestation of a king or ruler'.
